title: VQA-GEN: A Visual Question Answering Benchmark for Domain Generalization

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness to multimodal distribution shifts by applying controlled visual corruptions (noise injection, artistic style transfer) and textual variations (back-translation, conversational shifts) to measure cross-domain and in-domain accuracy drops.
Testing model performance on textual shifts generated by an LLM instructed to emulate distinct English writing styles and dialects prevalent in India, Britain, and the United States.

Evaluating model accuracy on questions rewritten using specific persona prompts representing different ages and educational backgrounds, such as elementary school student, high school student, college student, critic, and professor.
